channel.title: Bargain Hunt
channel.desc: They have been raising smiles for centuries, and in this episode, Eric Knowles learns about a unique clowning tradition. No two clowns should look alike, which is why their faces are copyrighted - on painted eggs! Professional clown Mattie Faint prompts a chuckle or two from Eric when he explains this egg-centric custom. Topping the bill on this show are two teams of antiques hunters, browsing hundreds of stalls at a huge fair with experts Nick Hall and Izzie Balmer.
